## FirstSun Capital Bancorp to Announce Third Quarter 2026 Results on Monday, October 26, 2026


October 13, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s25.q4cdn.com/782260447/files/doc_news/FirstSun-Capital-Bancorp-to-Announce-Third-Quarter-2026-Results-on-Monday-October-26-2026-2026.pdf)


DENVER--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


FirstSun Capital Bancorp ("FirstSun") (NASDAQ: FSUN) announced today that it will release third quarter 2026 financial results on Monday, October 26, 2026, after the market closes. Upon release, investors may access FirstSun’s financial results at FirstSun's website,[https://ir.firstsuncb.com/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.firstsuncb.com%2F&esheet=54620784&newsitemid=20261012628539&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fir.firstsuncb.com%2F&index=1&md5=d4d872abad1256f8c42284ea4341fa43) , in the[News section](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.firstsuncb.com%2Fnews%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54620784&newsitemid=20261012628539&lan=en-US&anchor=News+section&index=2&md5=6b99c5aa80cd1f18f39ad4c409af625d) .


FirstSun will host a conference call on Tuesday, October 27, 2026 at 11:00 a.m. (ET) to discuss its third quarter 2026 financial results. An audio replay of the live call is expected to be available following the live event on the[Events & Presentations page](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.firstsuncb.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54620784&newsitemid=20261012628539&lan=en-US&anchor=Events+%26amp%3B+Presentations+page&index=3&md5=dfb4a45f50d13e29786688d024e39a39) of FirstSun’s website.


**Conference Call Details**


Advance registration for the call is available[via this link](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F141121855&esheet=54620784&newsitemid=20261012628539&lan=en-US&anchor=via+this+link&index=4&md5=8d7d1f57db511d089768d58c402c59e0) . Access details will be provided by email upon completion of registration.


Participants may join the call toll-free by dialing (833) 461-5787 within the U.S. and (585) 542-9983 for all other locations. The conference Meeting ID is 141121855. Local numbers for international participants are listed[here](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fhelp.events.q4inc.com%2Feahc%2Finternational-dial-in-numbers&esheet=54620784&newsitemid=20261012628539&lan=en-US&anchor=here&index=5&md5=85c52f6783de03e0217c3179c00bb632) .


Alternatively, individuals may listen to the live webcast of the presentation by visiting the link on the[Events & Presentations page](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.firstsuncb.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54620784&newsitemid=20261012628539&lan=en-US&anchor=Events+%26amp%3B+Presentations+page&index=6&md5=4e1291fc25e40957c53e03e27b24885d) of FirstSun’s website.


**About FirstSun Capital Bancorp**


FirstSun Capital Bancorp (“FirstSun”) (NASDAQ: FSUN), headquartered in Denver, Colorado, is the financial holding company for wholly owned subsidiaries including Sunflower Bank, N.A. and FirstSun Advisors. Through its subsidiaries and affiliated entities, FirstSun provides a full range of relationship-focused services to meet personal, business, and wealth management financial objectives, with depository branches in ten states and mortgage capabilities in 44 states. FirstSun had total consolidated assets of $15.7 billion as of June 30, 2026.


To learn more, visit[ir.firstsuncb.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.firstsuncb.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54620784&newsitemid=20261012628539&lan=en-US&anchor=ir.firstsuncb.com&index=7&md5=527a3ca09b247b3594d65aeff7e8452e) or[SunflowerBank.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sunflowerbank.com%2F&esheet=54620784&newsitemid=20261012628539&lan=en-US&anchor=SunflowerBank.com&index=8&md5=6bd8a976bd8476764afd959bdd6974ee) .
